notes.title: Capture moments with the Forgers in SPYxANYA: Operation Memories, now available!
notes.content:
[h2]Create and cherish [b]joyful memories with the Forger Family[/b]![/h2]

Tasked with [b]making a photo diary as an assignment for Eden College[/b], players must take [b]memorable pictures of Anya[/b] to complete her diary from the series through [b]fun family outings to the park, beach, dog park, aquarium, and museum[/b].

[b]SPYxANYA: Operation Memories also includes a variety of more than 15 mini-games[/b] based on familiar scenes from the anime - ranging from [b]peanut-themed bowling to rhythm training with Yor[/b]. Players can earn points from mini-games and [b]unlock over 80 unique costumes and outing items[/b], including [b]clothing, accessories, and hairstyles for Anya, Loid, Yor, and Bond[/b].

[previewyoutube=8VCz8QyOcfc;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2][b] SPYxANYA: Operation Memories is now available[/b]![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2170370/SPYANYA_Operation_Memories/

notes.title: Join in on the Forger fun with SPYxANYA: Operation Memories!
notes.content:
[h2][b]The first console-game of “SPY×FAMILY” will be available on June 28! Play as Anya to experience the world of SPY×FAMILY.[/b][/h2]

[h3][b]Anya Forger has a new assignment[/b] from school: [b]create a photo diary[/b]! On weekdays, [b]go to school[/b], then [b]visit all sorts of exciting places like the beach or aquarium[/b] in search of [b]subjects to photograph[/b] on weekends.[/h3]

[previewyoutube=kQceBmmeHlU;full][/previewyoutube]
There are more than [b]80 types of clothes, accessories, and hairstyles[/b]! [b]Let's dress up[/b] and [b]go out in your style[/b].

More than [b]15 mini-games of various types[/b] that allow you to experience the [b]unique daily life in the "SPY×FAMILY"[/b] style are included. [b][i]Anya's telepathy may even allow her to read her opponent's hand of cards![/i][/b]

Enjoy the [b]precious time with family and friends[/b] across [b]various places including the school and home[/b].

[h3][b]Will Anya be able to complete her picture diary?[/b][/h3]

[h2][b]Stay tuned for further information and wishlist now![/b][/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2170370/SPYANYA_Operation_Memories/?curator_clanid=33042543
